fusions.name: Threaded Rot
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that threads spores into the wound, dealing 10 damage and leaving the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread through your mesh to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Fruiting Body
fusions.desc: Spores burst along your mesh, dealing 26 damage that ignores resistance to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaving each [Diseased] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Mycelial Mat
fusions.desc: Spreads a mat of living threads where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Seeded Threads
fusions.desc: Every hit you land plants a spore in your mesh on that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all burst at once, striking that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per spore (170% at full). Unfed, a spore fades every 4 seconds.
